newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U falls on CEO news overreaction-analysts.
newsitem.headline: P&U falls on CEO news overreaction-analysts.

text.p: The slide in the share prices of Swedish-U.S. drug company Pharmacia & Upjohn on news chief executive John Zabriskie would resign was unmotivated, analysts said on Monday.
At 1440 GMT the share traded at 270, down 14 crowns since its Friday closing price.

"I think the price fall is unmotivated because this is a company that is in the process of getting a hold of its business and Zabriskie's resignation does not affect that," said analyst Gustav Rhenman at Swedish brokerage Ohman.
P&U announced on Monday that Zabriskie would resign and return to the U.S. to pursue personal interests. He would temporarily be replaced by Jan Ekberg, head of the P&U board.
